The guidelines for authoring and reviewing documentation changes live in the agent skill
[`writing-documentation`](../../.agents/skills/writing-documentation/SKILL.md). Read that file and
follow it.

It is the single source of truth for language and German/English parity rules, anchor IDs, callouts,
dash usage, shell command prefixes and linking to API operations.
